name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: SEO & Growth Marketing Specialist
summary: Marketing operations and growth professional with 15+ years in MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments, including 4 years of hands-on SEO work spanning technical audits, keyword and competitor research, and schema/structured data implementation. Builds analytics and reporting infrastructure in GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Semrush, and connects organic performance to pipeline and revenue. Brings hands-on fluency building AI and LLM-driven systems as well, practical grounding for work that spans traditional SEO and answer-engine visibility.

bullets: Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog for site-wide SEO data pulls, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify and implement schema/structured data as part of technical SEO audits, pulling full on-page schema implementation.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Track acquisition and retention across multiple accounts using GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.

Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for service-based businesses, translating non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail verticals, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

bullets: Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
